bitwise_notes: order-sensitive data movement (index_put): accumulation / selection order must match eager exactly.
blockers: aten.index_put(_) under deterministic mode runs a sort-based path (memset/memcpy of the full destination); accumulate=True needs a deterministic segmented reduction. If the indices are a permutation (from sort/argsort), there are no duplicates and a gather/scatter is order-free.
